changelog:
- Initial release of the web3-data skill.
- Enables exploration of on-chain Web3 data using Chainbase APIs.
- Supports queries for token holders, wallet addresses, token prices, NFTs, ENS domains, DeFi portfolios, and other blockchain analytics across multiple EVM chains.
- Provides clear endpoint selection and quick reference for common data lookups.
- Includes SQL API fallback for complex or custom blockchain data queries.
summary: Explore Web3 on-chain data using Chainbase APIs. Use this skill when the user asks about blockchain data, token holders, wallet addresses, token prices, NFTs...
